title: Writing the one page the team can repeat back to you

videos.script: A strategy nobody remembers makes no decisions. {{title}} Somewhere a tech lead is planning a sprint right now, and the strategy page is not open in front of her. Whatever she remembers of it is the strategy, as far as that sprint is concerned. So this lesson is about writing one page that survives being remembered. {{page}} It has five headings. The diagnosis, the guiding policy and the actions come from lesson one. The other two make the page usable. One says how you will know it is working. The other says what the company will not do this year, by name. {{not}} That list is where the choice becomes visible, and where somebody's project lands. Coreto's page puts the microservices migration on it, and the people who lose hear it first in person. {{coreto}} Then comes the test. Ask five people to say the strategy back in their own words. Then give them a case the page never mentions. If they cannot answer, the page has to change. {{five}}
